dct_description_sm: Abstract: This map data layer represents the 2-foot interval topographic contour lines for the City of Cambridge, Massachusetts.

Purpose: Contour data can be used to determine the topography at any location in the City. The data can also be used for 3 dimensional modelling of the City terrain. These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mappng purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. Data may be useful for earth science analysis, topographic reference or display and analysis of terrain elevations.
